name: frontend-agent-playbook
description: Evidence-driven frontend judgment, audit, and approved-guidance workflows for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Retain ownership of AI-assisted frontend systems.
interface.longDescription: Diagnose and review frontend systems with evidence-driven judgment models, version-aware constraints, risk synthesis, and an explicit approval gate before project guidance is written.
defaultPrompt: Audit this frontend repository and propose up to three evidence-backed priorities.
Trace this frontend failure to a verified system boundary before proposing a fix.
Review this AI-generated frontend change and identify the ownership and verification gaps.
Check whether these frontend rules conflict with the current codebase.
Apply only the approved frontend guidance proposal.
